description: Owner defines branch name, code, address, city, phone, email, and receipt overrides.
automatic_actions: Generate unique branch_id scoped to business_id
Assign default cash account (e.g., Cash - Branch Code)
Initialize branch inventory records for existing catalog with 0 balance
Attach creating owner to branch_user pivot
invariants: Branch code must be unique within the business tenant.

description: Owner designates an active employee as Branch Manager.
automatic_actions: Assign Branch Manager role in Spatie team scope
invariants: Manager must belong to the same business tenant.

actor: Business Super Owner or Branch Manager
description: Cashiers, accountants, and inventory staff are attached to the branch.
automatic_actions: Enable POS terminal session binding for assigned cashiers
invariants: Staff can only perform POS checkouts in branches they are actively assigned to.

description: Branch operates POS sales, purchases, stock movements, and cash register sessions.
automatic_actions: All transactions tag branch_id and authenticated user_id
invariants: Zero shared login credentials; individual employee authentication enforced.

automatic_actions: Block new POS sales, purchases, and transfers targeting this branch
Preserve all historical ledgers, sales, and audit trails
invariants: Cannot delete branch if transactional history or non-zero inventory balance exists.
